title: Production Recovery live composition prerequisites and fail-closed release boundary

phases.objective: Pin and execute the fail-closed contract checks for the release sequence from fresh Staging certification through independent Production Recovery Store, complete server-managed authority graph, deployment attestation, artifact parity, activation eligibility, human approval, single-use ticket, fencing and same-cycle readback.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Fresh signed Staging Recovery certification evaluated by Production Recovery composition/readiness
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Production remains fail-closed until all independent live-authority prerequisites are satisfied; no database mutation is authorized by this change.
steps: Require a fresh Production-consumable Staging certification.
Require an independent durable Recovery Store outside runtime, governance and runtime_persistence.
Require the complete server-managed Production Recovery adapter graph and exact deployment attestation.
Require Staging-to-Production artifact parity and target binding before activation eligibility.
Reject direct caller construction of Production live authority and preserve the separate server-managed release gate.
Require a fresh typed human approval, server-side approval resolution, single-use execution ticket, fenced execution and independent same-cycle readback for every consequential step.
assertions: Empty target databases do not authorize rebuild without durable exact-SHA inspection evidence and immutable plan binding.
Runtime is never selected for empty rebuild when it contains objects.
Grant repair remains separate from schema rebuild.
Local Connector is never a Production Recovery authority or fallback.
Unknown provider outcome is reconciliation-only and cannot auto-replay.
Direct production_live construction remains forbidden and incomplete server-managed candidates remain fail-closed.
